  with the running API — and

  JSON:

  • what the deployed release actually calls —  release.requires . A grant not
  in that list is an                                                          
  unused grant, and  cdn.deploy  already reports them ( unusedGrants ); they  
  should be visible as                                                        
  such rather than looking identical to a grant something depends on.         
  • what the release calls that is not exposed — this is the one that refuses 
  a deploy, and it is                                                         
  worth showing before the deploy rather than as a 409 afterwards. It fired in
  production tonight:

    builder.release_repo, catalog.declare, and this release calls them.

  per contract.

  rules it encodes are

  unauthenticated. The

  questions, and conflating
